title: Travel: John Lennon – London to Cophenhagen | 1969
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from Heathrow Airport in London to Copenhagen, Denmark, on 27 December 1969.

They stayed in the Danish capital until 29 December, when they flew to Aalborg to see in the new year. While in Copenhagen they stayed at the Hotel d’Angleterre.
